Basis,"Invoices: The current approved Panel share on finalised invoices that are not void, including ones on a correction hold, counted on the day each invoice was finalised. Only Panels with invoices in the period appear. Claims: Claim figures are the amounts recorded on the claims now. Claimed means the claim was submitted at least once; a claim pack prepared but never submitted still counts as unclaimed. Decisions and payments: Accepted is what the Panel accepted; Rejected is the amount of claims the Panel fully rejected (not the unpaid part of a partial decision). Remitted is what the Panel has paid on claims, not patient receipts. Outstanding: Accepted less remitted, never below zero, as on the claim page; a claim not yet accepted is not counted as owed. Awaiting decision is the amount of submitted or queried claims with no Panel decision yet; it is not part of Outstanding. Ages: Counted up to today (branch time) from the first submitted date, for Outstanding and Awaiting decision; an unclaimed share ages from the day its invoice was finalised. Age groups: 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days. Notes: Amounts in MYR. Current Panel names; no patient details."
